SUBCONTRACT AGREEMENT - EXHIBIT A: SCOPE OF WORK
Project: Harbor View Medical Office Building, 1200 Harbor View Drive (fictional)
Contractor: Meridian Builders, LLC
Subcontractor: Keystone Interiors, Inc.
Subcontract No.: HV-0925-09
Date: 2026-01-15

1. Scope Inclusions
1.1 Furnish and install metal stud framing and gypsum board partitions as shown on drawings A-101 through A-104, Rev 0.
1.2 Soffits and bulkheads are included only where shown on A-501 (Reflected Ceiling Details), Rev 0.
1.3 Level 4 tape, finish and sand is included at all new gypsum board surfaces.
1.4 In-wall wood blocking for owner-furnished equipment is included only where shown on A-601, Rev 0.
2. Scope Exclusions
2.1 Repair of finished gypsum board damaged by other trades is excluded and will be performed only on written direction as extra work.
2.2 Framing or board at the Level 2 corridor ceiling is excluded; corridor ceilings are acoustical tile by others.

3. Changes
3.1 Extra work shall be performed only upon written direction from the Contractor's Project Manager or Superintendent.
3.2 Extra work will be priced at the rates in Exhibit B (Labor Rate Sheet); subcontractor markup on labor and material for extra work is 15%.
